title: Jacobi modular algorithm
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, apply the modular operation to the encoding of the subtraction of $[\mathrm{true}]$ from the encoding of the addition of the Jacobi algorithm's output on $z$ and the second decoded component of $z$, paired with that same second decoded component.
caveat: The encoding, decoding, addition, subtraction, and modular operations are not defined in the supplied payload, so their exact mathematical interpretation is uncertain.
